testcase.name: Step analysis is interrupted when exiting the section ([Issue #37](https://github.com/LionelDraghi/bbt/issues/37))

comparing an empty actual output with a non empty expected content shall fail normally, not raise an exception, and the scenario shall be counted as failed (bug present in bbt 0.4.2-dev, found on 2026-10-03 while migrating the ArchiCheck test suite)
test that `is equal to file` no more raise an exception when files are of different sizes, check Issue: #7
a step with a missing code block followed by a new Scenario header shall not crash the analysis (bug present in bbt 0.4.2-dev, found on 2026-10-03 while migrating the ArchiCheck test suite)
